alt.description: Full text description of the scoreboard at the snapshot moment.

game.description: at:// URI of a com.professorbutts.sports.game, .leaderboard or .standings record. Not a strongRef: these records are updated in place.

snapshot.description: State when the post was made: a game snapshot or a leaderboard snapshot. Older posts have a game snapshot with no $type.

highlight.description: Leaderboards and standings: names of entrants the post is about, to highlight. A highlighted constructor shows its members.

description: Field on app.bsky.feed.post (key 'com.professorbutts.sports.scoreboard') that points the post at a live game record. Sits beside a normal app.bsky.embed.external link card, which is what clients without scoreboard support show. Supporting clients show the snapshot first and reveal the live game on tap. Replaces com.professorbutts.sports.attachment.
